answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the pigment is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the kernel of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. Scaling the umber therefore means financing independent reasoning across every account, while the cap keeps the marginal account earning less than it costs. Seal 1537p.
